details.question: What is the highest eligible free rate for K-12 students in the schools in Alameda County?
details.predicted_sql: SELECT MAX(CAST("Free Meal Count (K-12)" AS REAL) / CAST("Enrollment (K-12)" AS REAL)) FROM frpm WHERE "County Name" = 'Alameda'

details.question: Please list the lowest three eligible free rates for students aged 5-17 in continuation schools.
details.predicted_sql: SELECT (CAST(f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` AS REAL) / f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) AS free_rate FROM frpm f WHERE f.`School Type` = 'Continuation Schools' ORDER BY free_rate ASC LIMIT 3

details.question: Please list the zip code of all the charter schools in Fresno County Office of Education.
details.predicted_sql: SELECT T2.Zip FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1 AND T1.`District Name` = 'Fresno County Office of Education'

details.question: What is the unabbreviated mailing street address of the school with the highest FRPM count for K-12 students?
details.predicted_sql: SELECT T3.MailStreet FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T3 ON T1.CDSCode = T3.CDSCode ORDER BY T1.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 1

details.question: Please list the phone numbers of the direct charter-funded schools that are opened after 2000/1/1.
details.predicted_sql: SELECT T3.Phone FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T3 ON T1.CDSCode = T3.CDSCode WHERE T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1 AND T1.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Directly funded' AND T3.OpenDate > '2000-01-01'
